messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "other medicines that lower blood pressure or heart rate"
set: ["other medicines that lower blood pressure or heart rate", "medicines that lower blood pressure", "blood pressure or heart rate", "other blood pressure medicines", "lower blood pressure", "check blood pressure and heart rate regularly", "taking other medicines to lower blood sugar", "patients taking other medicines that lower seizure threshold", "other heart failure medicines", "heart rate", "combination blood pressure medicines", "especially heart or blood pressure medication", "heart problems or high blood pressure", "tell doctor about all other heart or blood pressure medications", "medicines that slow the heart", "other medicines that cause drowsiness"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
